exposure: therapeutic phenylephrine boluses (100 micrograms for treatment of hypotension)
prophylactic phenylephrine infusion (100 micrograms/min for 3 minutes immediately after subarachnoid block)
cohort: 60 primiparous mothers scheduled for elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: Prophylactic phenylephrine infusion is more effective than therapeutic boluses in preventing hypotension during elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia, without significant differences in APGAR scores.
